seed 1103
== party setup for teleport
> Ann: party invite Bob
Ann: You invited <ansi fg="username">Bob</ansi> to your party.
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> invited you to their party. Type <ansi fg="command">party accept</ansi> or <ansi fg="command">party decline</ansi> to respond.
> Bob: party accept
Bob: You joined the party!
Ann: <ansi fg="username">Bob</ansi> joined the party!
== teleport Ann with Bob in her party to C
> Ann: teleport 93103
Ann: Moved to room 93103.
Cid: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> appears in a flash of light!
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> appears in a flash of light!
Bob: Moved to room 93103.
Cid: <ansi fg="username">Bob</ansi> is looking around.
Ann: <ansi fg="username">Bob</ansi> is looking around.

== locate Bob
> Ann: locate Bob
Ann: <ansi fg="username">Bob</ansi> is in room #<ansi fg="yellow-bold">93103</ansi> - <ansi fg="magenta">Room C</ansi> <ansi fg="red">【readszone】</ansi>
Bob: You get the feeling someone is looking for you...
== modify role bob mod
> Ann: modify role bob mod
Bob: <ansi fg="alert-3">Your role has been set to: mod</ansi>
Ann: Role changed for user <ansi fg="username">bob</ansi> (Character name: <ansi fg="username">Bob</ansi>).
== mute Bob
> Ann: mute Bob
Ann: <ansi fg="username">bob</ansi> (<ansi fg="username">Bob</ansi>) has been <ansi fg="alert-5">MUTED</ansi>
== grant Bob 10 xp
> Ann: grant Bob 10 xp
Bob: You gained <ansi fg="yellow-bold">10 experience points</ansi>! <ansi fg="7">(admin grant)</ansi>
Ann: Granted <ansi fg="experience">10 experience</ansi> to <ansi fg="username">Bob</ansi>.
== spawn gold 5
> Ann: spawn gold 5
Ann: You wave your hands around and <ansi fg="gold">5 gold</ansi> appears from thin air and falls to the ground.
Cid: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> waves their hands around and <ansi fg="gold">5 gold</ansi> appears from thin air and falls to the ground.
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> waves their hands around and <ansi fg="gold">5 gold</ansi> appears from thin air and falls to the ground.
== syslogs with no args
> Ann: syslogs
Ann: The <ansi fg="command">syslogs</ansi> command can be used to watch the server logs live.
Ann|
Ann| <ansi fg="command">syslogs on</ansi>  - Begin following all of the logs
Ann|
Ann| There are 4 levels of log importance you can enable. 
Ann| Each level includes all logs of higher importance levels.
Ann|
Ann| <ansi fg="13">DEBUG</ansi> - Debugging logs. May not be enabled on this server.
Ann| <ansi fg="2">INFO</ansi>  - General info that may or may not be useful.
Ann| <ansi fg="11">WARN</ansi>  - Non urgent/critical warnings.
Ann| <ansi fg="1">ERROR</ansi> - Very serious problems that should be tracked.
Ann|
Ann| Example:
Ann|     <ansi fg="command">syslogs info</ansi>  - Receive all <ansi fg="2">INFO</ansi>, <ansi fg="11">WARN</ansi>, and <ansi fg="1">ERROR</ansi> logs.
Ann|     <ansi fg="command">syslogs error</ansi>  - Receive only <ansi fg="1">ERROR</ansi> logs.
Ann|
Ann| <ansi fg="command">syslogs off</ansi> - Stop following the logs
Ann|
Ann|
